about: The plan plan/search.py chose per (L, n_batches) for the searched board (#172): the shared cut points c_1 < ... < c_{k-1} that batching.partition takes, k = n_batches // 3, and one explicit sieve seed order per batch, in partition order -- a permutation of that batch's targets [rx, ry, rz], climbed from one of plan.recovery.seed_orders(widened=True) (named in 'start'). The chosen plan is frontier[selected]; replay any point with plan.search.searched_plan(L, n_batches, cut, orders); do not re-search. Each cell records its frontier -- the feasible plans' Pareto set over (max_intermediates, flops), ascending in max_intermediates -- so a reader with another exchange rate between the two can re-select without re-searching (#171). 'space' is what was searched; the build step is `python -m felizjueves.plan search`.

objective.frontier: the feasible plans whose (max_intermediates, flops) no other feasible plan's weakly dominates, one plan per distinct point
objective.select: minimise max_intermediates / intermediates_min + flops / flops_min over the frontier (the minima are the frontier's), in exact rationals; equal scores to the fewer max_intermediates
objective.rule: Among feasible plans (max targets within `MINIMAX_TOLERANCE` of the cell's minimax), take the Pareto frontier over (max_intermediates, FLOPs) and select the point minimising `intermediates / intermediates_min + flops / flops_min`, intermediates breaking ties. Equal weight because the paper prints the two in separate tables and trades them against each other without naming a price; normalised because the two quantities differ by an order of magnitude and an unnormalised sum would be a FLOPs-only rule wearing a disguise.
objective.ties: one plan per point: the first met -- within a batch, starts in seed_orders(widened=True) order and each climb's evaluation order; across batches, order_search.product's nested order; across cuts, lowest cut points first

space.cuts: every shared contiguous cut batching.partition accepts whose largest batch is within minimax_tolerance of the cell's minimax
space.starts: per batch, plan.recovery.seed_orders(widened=True)'s 58 rules restricted to the batch's targets, one per distinct order, named by the first rule that gives it; all are evaluated, and those on the batch's frontier of them (no other start's point weakly dominates theirs, one per point) are climbed
space.climb: plan.order_search.climb, one start at a time against the batch's reference point (the best intermediates and the best flops over its starts): first-improvement, strictly better steps only, each run ending at a local optimum or after 'budget' neighbours examined
space.combine: per batch the frontier of every order its climbs evaluated; per cut plan.order_search.product of its batches' frontiers (max intermediates, summed flops); over the feasible cuts the frontier; then 'select'
